translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: عند تفعيل هذا الخيار، لا تسجّل اللعبة الدخول أبدًا من أجل لوحة الصدارة ولا تعرض زر لوحة الصدارة. تسديدة اليوم ونتيجتها وسلسلتك تبقى تعمل كما هي.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Wenn das an ist, meldet sich das Spiel nie für die Rangliste an und zeigt keine Schaltfläche „Rangliste“. Der Stoß des Tages, seine Punkte und deine Serie funktionieren weiter.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Con esto activado, el juego nunca inicia sesión para la clasificación y no muestra el botón Clasificación. El tiro del día, su puntuación y tu racha siguen funcionando.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Avec cette option, le jeu ne se connecte jamais pour le classement et n'affiche pas le bouton Classement. Le coup du jour, son score et ta série fonctionnent toujours.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Con questa opzione attiva, il gioco non accede mai per la classifica e non mostra il pulsante Classifica. Il colpo del giorno, il suo punteggio e la tua serie funzionano comunque.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: オンにすると、ゲームはランキングのためにサインインせず、「ランキング」ボタンも表示しません。今日のショット、そのスコア、連続記録はそのまま使えます。

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: 켜 두면 게임이 순위표를 위해 로그인하지 않고 순위표 버튼도 보이지 않습니다. 오늘의 샷과 점수, 연속 기록은 그대로 작동합니다.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Com isto ligado, o jogo nunca inicia sessão para a classificação e não mostra o botão Classificação. A tacada do dia, a sua pontuação e a tua série continuam a funcionar.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Com isto ativado, o jogo nunca entra na conta para a classificação e não mostra o botão Classificação. A tacada do dia, a pontuação dela e a sua sequência continuam funcionando.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: Если это включено, игра никогда не входит в учётную запись ради рейтинга и не показывает кнопку «Рейтинг». Удар дня, его очки и твоя серия по-прежнему работают.

translations.key: With this on, the game never signs in for the board and shows no Board button. Today's shot, its score and your streak still work.
translations.text: 开启后，游戏不会为排行榜登录，也不显示“排行榜”按钮。今日一杆、它的得分和你的连胜照常可用。
